class.name: VoxelVolume3D
class.brief_description: Renders a sparse, editable 3D voxel volume.
class.description: Displays [member voxel_data] by ray marching sparse 8 × 8 × 8 bricks inside a procedural box proxy. Palette index [code]0[/code] is empty; indices [code]1..255[/code] are occupied and address the textures stored by [VoxelShapeData]. The node origin is the minimum corner of voxel [code](0, 0, 0)[/code]. The local bounds are [member VoxelShapeData.dimensions] multiplied by [member VoxelShapeData.voxel_size]. Use the coordinate conversion methods instead of duplicating this calculation when the node may be transformed. The assigned [VoxelMaterial] stores authored settings. A resident node creates a private runtime material and GPU textures, so multiple volumes can safely share the same authored material without making nonresident volumes pay the GPU setup cost. When [code]rendering/voxel_volume/shadow_proxy/enabled[/code] is enabled, a resident volume casts conventional shadows from an exact voxel-resolution shadow-only mesh instead of rerunning the visible DDA shader in every shadow-map cascade. Runtime voxel edits rebuild this mesh. For collision, assign the same [VoxelShapeData] to a [VoxelShape3D] used by a [CollisionShape3D].

method.name: apply_voxel_edits
method.description: Applies a batch of coordinate-based edits to [member voxel_data] and returns the number of cells that changed. Both arrays must have the same length. Invalid coordinates are skipped.

method.name: apply_voxel_edits_by_index
method.description: Applies edits using X-major linear voxel indices and returns the number of cells that changed. Both arrays must have the same length. Invalid indices are skipped.

method.name: fill_voxel_region
method.description: Fills the axis-aligned region in [member voxel_data], clipped to its dimensions, and returns the number of cells that changed. Palette index [code]0[/code] clears cells.

method.name: get_streaming_distance
method.description: Returns this volume's automatic-streaming distance override.

method.name: get_streaming_mode
method.description: Returns the residency policy used by the streaming manager.

method.name: get_voxel
method.description: Returns the palette index at [param position], or [code]0[/code] when no voxel resource is assigned or the position is outside its bounds.

method.name: get_voxel_data
method.description: Returns the voxel resource rendered by this node.

method.name: get_voxel_material
method.description: Returns the lightweight authored material configuration.

method.name: is_streaming_resident
method.description: Returns whether this volume currently owns its GPU brick textures and render proxy.

method.name: local_to_voxel
method.description: Converts a local-space point to a voxel coordinate by dividing by voxel size and flooring each component. The result is not clamped.

method.name: make_voxel_data_unique
method.description: Deep-duplicates [member voxel_data] and assigns the duplicate to this node. Use before editing when the original resource is shared but this volume should diverge.

method.name: set_streaming_distance
method.description: Sets the non-negative camera-distance override. Zero uses the global [code]rendering/voxel_volume/streaming_distance[/code] setting.

method.name: set_streaming_mode
method.description: Selects automatic, always-resident, or manual residency control.

method.name: set_streaming_resident
method.description: Loads or releases this volume's GPU resources. Always-resident mode forces this to [code]true[/code]. CPU voxel data is retained when nonresident.

method.name: set_voxel
method.description: Writes one cell in [member voxel_data]. Returns [code]true[/code] only when the stored value changes. The palette index must be in [code]0..255[/code].

method.name: set_voxel_data
method.description: Assigns the voxel resource, connects its change notifications, and rebuilds resident GPU textures.

method.name: set_voxel_material
method.description: Copies the material's authored shading settings and rebuilds this volume's private runtime material.

method.name: voxel_to_local
method.description: Returns the local-space center of [param voxel], or its minimum corner when [param center] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: voxel_to_world
method.description: Returns the transformed world-space center of [param voxel], or its minimum corner when [param center] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: world_to_voxel
method.description: Transforms a world-space point into the volume's local space and converts it to a voxel coordinate. The result is not clamped.

members.member: Automatic-streaming distance override in world units. Zero uses the global project setting.
Whether GPU textures and render geometry are currently resident.
The sparse voxel resource rendered by this node.
Shared authored shading configuration. Assign the same resource to multiple volumes to update all of them together; volume-specific GPU textures remain private.

constants.constant: The manager evaluates camera distance and the global resident-volume budget every 12 process frames.
Keeps rendering resources resident regardless of camera distance or budget.
